description: Lux AI puts Lux Research's curated analyst knowledge one question away. Ask about emerging technologies, companies, markets, and academic research, and get answers drawn from Lux's proprietary publications. Every claim carries a source citation linking back to the underlying research, so you go from question to a defensible, sourced answer in seconds. Requires an active Lux Research subscription with your organization.

defaultPrompt: What emerging technologies should be on my radar for synthetic biology innovation?
